title: Conformal Prediction for Time-Dependent PDEs
abstract: arXiv:2611.08409v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Uncertainty quantification is crucial in scientific machine learning, where models inform safety-critical tasks such as flood forecasting, financial risk management, and thermal control in machines. Conformal prediction provides distribution-free coverage guarantees, but in time-dependent settings common to physics and engineering, these guarantees can break down, leading to systematic undercoverage. We study this problem in the context of surrogate models for time-dependent physical systems described by partial differential equations. We prove that in a function space setting, distributions at arbitrarily close times can be mutually singular, making exact coverage guarantees impossible. We further show that in discretized settings, the total variation distance between distributions often saturates exponentially fast with the grid resolution, mandating restrictions on the spatial discretization to ensure coverage. translated_title: 时间依赖偏微分方程的共形预测
translated_abstract: 不确定性量化在科学机器学习中至关重要，因为模型的输出会为洪水预报、金融风险管理以及机器热控制等安全关键任务提供依据。共形预测能够提供无分布假设的覆盖保证，但在物理和工程中常见的时间依赖场景下，这些保证可能失效，导致系统性的覆盖不足。我们在由偏微分方程描述的时间依赖物理系统的代理模型背景下研究这一问题。我们证明，在函数空间设定下，任意接近的两个时刻的分布可以相互奇异，使得精确的覆盖保证不可能实现。我们进一步表明，在离散化设定下，分布之间的全变差距离往往随网格分辨率的提高而呈指数级饱和，这要求对空间离散化施加限制才能确保覆盖。最后，对于某些……
tldr: 本文证明了时间依赖偏微分方程的共形预测覆盖保证在本质上难以实现——函数空间中相近时刻的分布可相互奇异，离散化中全变差距离随网格分辨率指数饱和——并给出了为确保覆盖而对空间离散化施加的必要限制。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that exact coverage guarantees for conformal prediction of time-dependent PDEs are fundamentally impossible—due to mutual singularity of distributions at nearby times in function space and exponential saturation of total variation distance with grid resolution—and derives necessary restrictions on spatial discretization to ensure coverage.
